content.title: Easter Monday supermarket opening times, from Aldi to Waitrose
content.text: With Easter Monday upon us, it’s time to lay out your plans – top of the list, what food you’ll be eating. The hallmarks of the springtime holiday have arrived: weather warming up, days becoming longer, and the seasonal delights from the best hot cross buns to the best Easter eggs springing up on our supermarket shelves. Planning a big Easter feast or just popping out for a top-up on chocolate? It’s always worth double-checking supermarket opening times before you leave the house. The bank holiday weekend often brings reduced or revised hours, and there’s nothing more frustrating than turning up to closed doors.To make things easier, we’ve rounded up the latest Easter opening times for the UK’s major supermarkets. Just bear in mind that hours can vary by location, especially for smaller convenience stores, so it’s a good idea to check with your local branch before setting off.Read more: Tesco’s English sparkling wine is made just like champagneSainsbury’s Good Friday: 7am-11pm, normal trading hours (convenience stores) Easter Saturday: 7am-11pm, normal trading hours (convenience stores) Easter Sunday: Closed, open as normal (Scotland) Easter Monday: 8am-8pm, normal trading hours (convenience stores) Read more: Sainsbury’s lamb is ‘better than half price’ right nowWaitroseGood Friday: Open with reduced hours (last year this was generally 8am-8pm) Easter Saturday: No changes announcedEaster Sunday: Closed, with a select number of Little Waitrose stores openEaster Monday: Open with reduced hours (last year this was generally 8am-8pm) TescoGood Friday: 6am-10pm (England, Wales and Isle of Man);
